files.finance/carriage-rates-2026.md:
# Carriage rates, 2026

- Zone Local: $0.84 per kg
- Zone Regional: $1.32 per kg
- Zone Highland: $2.05 per kg

Consignments over 90 kg go on the pallet network at a flat $58.40 per
consignment, whatever the zone; the per-kg rates above do not apply to them.
